title: Research: exclude P112 4,5^2,6^8 by weighted flat pairs
body:
## Summary

Exclude the actual eleven-piece P112 TWOSIDE `(7,4)` profile `4,5^2,6^8` over every characteristic-zero field. This answers PR3176's adjacent-profile handoff.

```text
Eight weight-six endpoints allow 160 support incidences.
Mixed root/D7 case: lower bound 162.
Ordinary root-A7 case: lower bound 168.
Exceptional root-A7 case:
  arbitrary deletion bound 158 fails;
  retain the two five-flats and the orthogonal frame;
  new weighted flat-pair lemma gives 162.
```

`research/p112-weighted-flat-pair/` contains the proof, deterministic certificate, separate finite check, source pins and reproduction instructions. Commit `595a78f7925c8802f764792098806ebfbff1f27a` starts from canonical main `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, priority revision 6. No frozen predecessor is changed.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3176 leaves this profile open; its exceptional root branch gives only 158 against allowance 160 after arbitrary deletions.
- After: complete coverage of 3,309,747 five-flats, 2,025 frames and 9,737 mixed six-cliques. The alternate algorithm reconstructs all 3,248 high-cost masks from 5,124 root-generated spaces and checks every frame without orbit reduction.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and all sixteen optimized behavioral groups pass. Read-only Git-free Python 3.13 replay, including the exact committed export, also passes. Ruff, warning-as-error compilation, exact source origins and all 21 package/input publication-byte comparisons pass.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
RUN="$HOME/.cache/integer-mult-bounds-runs/p112-weighted-flat-pair-replay"
mkdir -p "$RUN"
TMPDIR="$RUN" python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p112-weighted-flat-pair
```

Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 at `708f0ad8928c383de8294aea3c126e9461d2066d` for TWOSIDE and the C5 handoff, Nick Petalas/PR3176 at `1111a074414c4d2be8b4e230133d873432780814` for the mixed alphabet and retained geometry, and the E8/P112 lineage preserved in the source notices.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19000159). A [later same-profile claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19000168) is disclosed, not treated as exclusivity or evidence; it had no public artifact at the overlap checkpoint. No input from it was used.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated research package.

Author-checked proof and finite evidence, not independent human or proof-kernel review. The standard Weyl-chamber theorem and original decoder reduction remain dependencies. Both programs share retained geometry and the primary census's full120 five-flat capacity twelve. This does not close the full cell, C5 or `C(P112)>=64`, admit a supplier, or change selected kappa. Hosted CI is separate. Development and local checks used substantial automated assistance.
